book: EPS-TOPIK Standard Korean Textbook 1 & 2 (Bangla self-study) - vocabulary by lesson (1-60)
source_note: Built from each book's word index (어휘 색인); each word is assigned to the lesson whose page range contains its page number. Lessons 1-30 are from Book 1, lessons 31-60 from Book 2 (page numbers refer to the respective book). Each word also has an 'english' meaning. Lessons 61-66 are extra words (Topic 1 to Topic 6) added from kfluent.com vocabulary; words already in lessons 1-60 were skipped. Within Topic 1-6, categories with fewer than 15 words were merged into the most similar category of the same topic, so every Topic 1-6 category has at least 15 words.
